title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Ethan Brooks
description: Context: We need canonical RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples to speed onboarding for developers using agents and external tooling. This PR adds curated quickstarts, example agents that demonstrate tool calling patterns (sync/async), and docs site updates to surface the new content. Motivation: reduce support load for common RAG use cases, provide vetted templates that follow best practices for prompt design, tool schemas, and secure tool integration. Changes include templates (YAML), Python and TypeScript examples, test coverage for docs links, and mkdocs sidebar updates. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates (basic and advanced) - [x] Add tool-calling examples with sample tools (calendar, flight-booking, search) - [x] Add quickstart docs pages and quickstart TOC - [x] Add Dockerfile for local agent sandbox - [x] Add basic link tests and docs preview CI step - [x] Update mkdocs.yml sidebar and redirects Notes: docs live-preview was used to validate pages. This PR intentionally keeps examples small and focused; a follow-up will add additional language bindings and more advanced evals (ENG-3301). Links: quickstart page: /quickstarts/rag-agent, examples root: /examples/agents/tool-calling.
commits: 9 commits: initial templates and README; add flight-booking tool example; add calendar and search mock tools; docs pages and TOC; add Dockerfile and build script; add docs link tests; fix broken link reported in review; update example prompts for clarity; final copy edits
